about: Polling loops tools/polling-guard/polling_scan.py lets stay, each with why. Waits use one glaeda-gh wait. An entry is only for a bounded loop with no glaeda-gh to wait through. match is the loop's first line, stripped. An entry that matches nothing fails the scan.

entries.reason: Runs once per runner install on a Quarry host, right after the runner registers, to confirm GitHub sees it online. glaeda-gh has no runner wait and need not be on that host. Bounded at 15 reads over 30 s, then a hard failure.
